ops.body: Shipped and closing. cc-pane a777703eb6ba ("agent actions: kill, message, respawn, attach") pushed to main, all three CI workflows green. Scope grew respawn (user opt-in) beyond the original attach/kill/message. Full live e2e passed against deliberately spawned tmux and zellij agents: CLI attach happy paths with focus + clean detach (exit 0), error matrix (bogus id / non-active → one stderr line + exit 1; unsupported-backend case skipped — no cmux/herd/superset agent cheaply available), TUI message with exact channel delivery, TUI attach suspend/resume, kill with confirm modal, respawn of a killed agent, eligibility flashes, clean quit with no leaked processes, and daemon-unreachable header (only reachable when auto-wake can't restart the daemon — see the "Agent actions wire facts" note). One bug found live and fixed pre-ship: the prompt-opening key leaked into the input via OpenTUI's two-phase dispatch; fixed with a preventDefault veto on the none→prompt transition + a mockInput-driven regression test (route()-driven tests cannot catch this class). Installed cco swapped codesign-safe to a current main build (attach-capable); prior 0.3.0 binary preserved at /tmp/cc-attach-e2e/cco-0.3.0.bak. cc-orchestrate side rode out earlier on 17bc52f (see reconciliation comment).
